scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Within the first four minutes of the call ([00:33]), the agent only asked for the customer's account number and date of birth, failing to verify her address or security PIN until [08:27]—more than four minutes into the call.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Despite the customer expressing severe distress ([00:13], [01:12], [06:54]) about being without internet for two weeks and paying to work from a coffee shop, the agent never once apologized or acknowledged her feelings.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: At [00:59], the agent jumped straight into reading raw order status codes without ever paraphrasing or restating the customer's two-week home-move activation delay in his own words.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [09:30] and [15:33], the agent refused to take ownership of the wayleave contact error, blaming the home-move provisioning department ('that's their department not mine') and instructing the customer to call them herself tomorrow morning.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At [12:17], the agent made a dismissive, sarcastic remark to the customer: 'Well, moving into a newly converted Victorian building and expecting fibre to magically appear on day one is a bit optimistic, isn't it?'

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: At [17:48]-[18:14], the customer's home-move fibre order remained stuck on wayleave hold WL-09 with no installation date and no temporary broadband backup provided.

grader.scenario: Home move fibre activation delayed by two weeks leaving customer without internet in her new flat
grader.notes: Poor home-move delay call failing 6 items (V, E, PA, O, R, RE) while passing B, H, P, AL, and PR. Tests five hard cases: late Verification ([08:27] past the 240s cutoff after only asking account number + DOB at [00:33]), complete lack of Empathy despite -45.0 customer distress, a sarcastic Professionalism failure at [12:17], Dead Air PASS with 1 unmanaged 45s gap ([06:08]) and 1 managed 65s hold ([11:45]) staying below the >=2 unmanaged fail threshold, and strong technical Probing ([01:56]-[03:37]) into MDU ducts and CSP hardware despite poor soft skills.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good afternoon, thank you for calling S-Net Customer Support.' and [18:22] Agent: 'Thank you for choosing S-Net, and goodbye.'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Only one unmanaged gap >30s occurred ([05:13]-[06:08], 45s without hold announcement), while the second gap ([10:30]-[11:45], 65s) was properly announced with 'Please bear with me...' and closed with 'Thanks for waiting'; since fewer than 2 unmanaged gaps >30s occurred, Dead Air is PASS.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:33] Agent only asks for account number and date of birth; Agent does not ask for street address or security PIN until [08:27] (after the 240-second verification window).
